item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-4c16e690a530cc45","start_unit":10,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Bangladesh was a Chemical Weapons Convention member during 2023, having signed in 1993 and ratified in 1997; the OPCW page identifies a Bangladesh National Authority and records prior chemical-emergency preparedness and dual-use chemical-security training activities.","question_ids":["1B.4","1B.6","1B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Bangladesh's treaty status applied in 2023, but the listed training activities occurred in 2022 or earlier and the source does not establish Sheikh Hasina's personal role or 2023 implementation.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes the institutional status to Bangladesh, not specifically to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["No 2023 compliance, inspection, funding, enforcement, or correction evidence is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4f1d5a1459d0a908","start_unit":12,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"The World Bank country page reports that women held 21% of seats in Bangladesh's national parliament in 2023 and gives a statistical performance score of 71.6 for 2024; most other displayed indicators are for years outside 2023.","question_ids":["4B.7","5B.7","6B.5"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The parliamentary representation figure is period-fitting; the statistical-performance figure is post-period and the page does not attribute either outcome to Sheikh Hasina.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to the ruler.","limitations":["The page does not provide 2023 trend, policy, implementation, distribution, or accountability evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-653ea2b5b2a2a734","start_unit":12,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"The World Bank country page reports that women held 21% of seats in Bangladesh's national parliament in 2023 and gives a statistical performance score of 71.6 for 2024; most other displayed indicators are for years outside 2023.","question_ids":["4B.7","5B.7","6B.5"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The parliamentary representation figure is period-fitting; the statistical-performance figure is post-period and the page does not attribute either outcome to Sheikh Hasina.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to the ruler.","limitations":["This is a duplicate-language version of the same World Bank country profile and adds no independent evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-b481e1bfd07f808e","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"WHO's Bangladesh publications page lists a 2023 Expanded Programme on Immunization factsheet and a 2020–2025 Country Cooperation Strategy; the strategy description says Bangladesh had made socioeconomic progress, including poverty reduction and improved women's education, while a WHO assessment states the government was committed to equitable healthcare access.","question_ids":["6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.10","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The publications and strategy were available during 2023, but the excerpt provides no 2023 outcome data or direct attribution of the progress to Sheikh Hasina.","ruler_attribution":"The healthcare commitment is attributed to the Government of Bangladesh, not specifically to the prime minister.","limitations":["No budget, staffing, implementation, uptake, audit, or distribution evidence is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c519eac9e7e02192","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In October 2023, Bangladesh's government nominated Sheikh Hasina's daughter Saima Wazed for the WHO South-East Asia Regional Office director position. Critics described the nomination and the use of the Prime Ministerial Office to engage foreign leaders as nepotism, contrasting Wazed's qualifications with the competing candidate's longer senior WHO and public-health experience; the foreign minister publicly supported Wazed and urged Nepal's candidate to withdraw.","question_ids":["5B.2","6B.4","7B.3","7B.5","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns 2023 and the sitting prime minister's office, but allegations are contested and the source does not establish a final finding of improper conduct.","ruler_attribution":"The government nomination and reported use of the Prime Ministerial Office are linked to Sheikh Hasina's administration; the nepotism allegation is made by critics.","limitations":["The article reports competing claims and does not establish whether the nomination violated WHO rules or produced personal financial benefit."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6f99846739a69087","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In April 2023, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina called Prothom Alo an enemy of the Awami League, democracy, and the people after its cost-of-living report. Journalist Shamsuzzaman Shams was arrested and charged under the Digital Security Act, editor Matiur Rahman was sued, and the article reports office intimidation; Amnesty characterized these events and the closure of the opposition-linked Daily Dinkal as part of a broader repression of independent media. It also reports 56 journalists were tortured, harassed, sued, intimidated, or obstructed in the first three months of 2023.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9","7B.1","7B.2","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns events in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina's public statement is directly attributed to her; arrests, lawsuits, and media restrictions are attributed to Bangladeshi authorities.","limitations":["The source is an Amnesty International assessment and does not provide court findings on each case."]},{"source_id":"SRC-12d53043b2ae046e","start_unit":3,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The World Bank's October 2023 Bangladesh Development Update reported that strong economic performance had reduced extreme poverty to 5.0% in 2022 from 9.0% in 2016, with improvements in infant mortality, stunting, electricity, sanitation, and education; it also reported slower FY23 growth, rising inflation, balance-of-payments pressure, power and gas shortages, and deepening financial-sector vulnerabilities, and called for reforms in monetary policy, exchange rates, finance, governance, and domestic resource mobilization.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","5B.7","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.5","6B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Published in October 2023; several outcome figures refer to 2022 or FY23 and therefore provide context rather than a complete 2023 attribution.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes Bangladesh-wide performance and government-related vulnerabilities and reforms, without assigning personal responsibility to Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The poverty series used a revised methodology and is not fully comparable with prior years; the source does not isolate the ruler's causal contribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-77cbfd3c93068749","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"At a May 2023 event attended by Sheikh Hasina, the UN Resident Coordinator said Bangladesh was the world's largest contributor of uniformed UN peacekeeping personnel, with more than 7,400 military and police personnel serving in 14 countries, and noted Bangladesh's pledge to increase female participation under its 2019 Women, Peace and Security action plan; 572 women were then deployed.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.4","2B.5","2B.7","2B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly describes Bangladesh's peacekeeping posture in May 2023, while some institutional history predates the period.","ruler_attribution":"The UN speaker attributes the contribution to Bangladesh; attendance by Hasina does not establish that she personally directed each deployment.","limitations":["No evidence is provided on domestic authorization, budgets, rules of engagement, investigations, or causal outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5d3ed7bb6f8bf2be","start_unit":1,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The UN treaty record shows Bangladesh signed the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons in 2017 and ratified it in 2019, with the ratification taking effect in January 2021; therefore Bangladesh was a party throughout 2023.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The legal status was in force during 2023, although the relevant decisions occurred before the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The treaty record attributes the action to Bangladesh and does not identify Sheikh Hasina's personal role.","limitations":["No 2023 implementation, reporting, operational posture, or enforcement evidence is included."]},{"source_id":"SRC-48d37d1e3255e2b0","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"As of March 2023, Bangladesh hosted nearly 961,000 Rohingya refugees and led a 2023 Joint Response Plan for refugees and host communities. The plan prioritized voluntary and sustainable repatriation, protection, life-saving assistance, host-community welfare, and disaster-risk management, while Bangladesh planned to relocate 100,000 refugees to Bhasan Char; the briefing records concerns that the island was flood-prone, remote, and that some relocations were involuntary. It also reports that safe and dignified return conditions in Myanmar did not exist and that Bangladesh pursued a pilot repatriation scheme despite warnings from Human Rights Watch.","question_ids":["2B.1","2B.7","2B.10","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.8","6B.10","8B.2","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns the humanitarian response and policy debates in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The plan and relocation policy are attributed to the Government of Bangladesh; the source does not separately identify Hasina's personal decisions.","limitations":["The briefing summarizes reported concerns and does not independently assess all implementation results or the voluntariness of every relocation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-7c27da0b808a1506","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International reported that during BNP protests on 28–29 July 2023, Bangladeshi police used tear gas and rubber bullets against largely peaceful protesters, including near a hospital, and verified videos of officers beating unarmed protesters and a senior opposition politician. It also reported armed civilians in plain clothes attacking protesters alongside police and called for independent investigations and accountability.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns July 2023 events.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the conduct to Bangladeshi authorities, police, and alleged ruling-party supporters; it does not document a direct order from Sheikh Hasina.","limitations":["The source verifies evidence of conduct but does not establish the prime minister's personal knowledge or command responsibility."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-6ce39439279e3f10"],"batch_limitations":["The supplied documents are mostly country-level or institutional sources; direct personal attribution to Sheikh Hasina is limited.","No score is assigned."]}
